Levy Harkins & Company Increased Its Position in Apple (AAPL) by $4.94 Million as Share Value Declined; As Tiffany & Co New (TIF) Valuation Declined, London Co Of Virginia Raised Stake
May 1, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Levy Harkins & Company Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 17.29% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Levy Harkins & Company Inc bought 29,252 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 198,454 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $33.58 million, up from 169,202 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Levy Harkins & Company Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $845.12 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.79% or $1.2982 $166.5582. About 4.57 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
